mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.level, r.name, r.parent_id, r.centroid_lng, r.centroid_lat, r.bbox_west, r.bbox_south, r.bbox_east, r.bbox_north, ne.type, COUNT(ne.id) AS count FROM regions r JOIN network_elements ne ON ne.${regionColumn} = r.id WHERE r.level = #{level} AND r.geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326) AND (#{types}::text[] IS NULL OR ne.type = ANY(#{types}::text[])) AND (#{propFilter}::text IS NULL OR ne.properties @> #{propFilter}::jsonb) GROUP BY r.id, r.level, r.name, r.parent_id, r.centroid_lng, r.centroid_lat, r.bbox_west, r.bbox_south, r.bbox_east, r.bbox_north, ne.type ORDER BY r.id, ne.type
